title: Multi-Label Sentiment Analysis on 100 Languages with Dynamic Weighting for Label Imbalance
abstract: arXiv:2008.11573v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We investigate cross-lingual sentiment analysis, which has attracted significant attention due to its applications in various areas including market research, politics and social sciences. In particular, we introduce a sentiment analysis framework in multi-label setting as it obeys Plutchik's wheel of emotions. We introduce a novel dynamic weighting method that balances the contribution from each class during training, unlike previous static weighting methods that assign non-changing weights based on their class frequency. Moreover, we adapt the focal loss that favors harder instances from single-label object recognition literature to our multi-label setting. Furthermore, we derive a method to choose optimal class-specific thresholds that maximize the macro-f1 score in linear time complexity. translated_title: 基于动态加权的100种语言多标签情感分析（针对标签不平衡问题）
translated_abstract: 我们研究跨语言情感分析，该领域因其在市场研究、政治和社会科学等多个领域的应用而受到广泛关注。特别是，由于情感遵循普拉奇克情感轮模型，我们引入了一个多标签设置下的情感分析框架。我们提出了一种新颖的动态加权方法，在训练过程中平衡每个类别的贡献，这不同于以往根据类别频率分配固定权重的静态加权方法。此外，我们将单标签目标识别文献中偏向较难样本的焦点损失（focal loss）适配到我们的多标签设置中。进一步地，我们推导出一种在线性时间复杂度内选择最优类别特定阈值以最大化宏平均F1分数的方法。通过大量实验，我们证明我们的方法在3个不同（数据集）的9个指标中有7个取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种动态加权方法来应对多标签情感分析中的标签不平衡问题，并结合适配的多标签焦点损失与线性时间复杂度的最优阈值选择方法，在100种语言的情感分析任务中于9个指标中的7个上达到了最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel dynamic weighting method to address label imbalance in multi-label sentiment analysis, combining an adapted focal loss and a linear-time optimal threshold selection approach, achieving state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 9 metrics across 100 languages.
